These '''probe droids''', colored red and white and resembling a saucer, were equipped with blaster weapons and could also drop round grenades that could levitate and follow their target. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] encountered them in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] rooftops while attempting to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|pursue]] an [[Zam Wesell/Legends|attempted assassin]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' video game]]</ref>
